164180.overview:
Undermine is a 1-player arcade game for the VIC-20.

The player controls a bat within a small cavern. To the north are the wide plains of Xylon, to the south lies the open sea, protected by a storm wall. A ball bounces about inside the cavern, and the player tries to direct the ball to break away the wall to the north while trying not to hit the wall to the south. The player determines game speed and the thickness of the sea wall, and if the storm wall breaks, the cavern floods, and it's game over.

164226.overview: You have been imprisoned by the Garrintrots in the mountain stronghold of Mount Drash. There are 15 levels of tunnels within the mountain, and you must find the exit in each one to escape. Some levels have gems which must be collected before you are allowed to leave. Along the way you will encounter a variety of enemy creatures which will need to be defeated in combat. Only released for the VIC-20, it is a simple maze game with some monster battles, and very little connection to the other games in the series.
